task: D72b cross-detector probe for CVE-2025-26474 source pair
method: Direct invocation of CppBoundsDetector and CppIntegerBoundsDetector on each single C++ SourceUnit parsed through src.parser.ast.parse_source; exact Git objects retrieved with git show.

interpretation.known_root_cause: For positive N the vulnerable function requests N bytes for int32_t[N] and int64_t[N] but writes 4N and 8N bytes respectively; fixed source scales each allocation by sizeof(element).
interpretation.detector_result: Neither the current B/IPC DATA-02 rules nor A-BOF-01/A-INT-01 produced a finding on the single-file source pair. This cross-check found no existing generic detector hit in these two candidate families.
interpretation.scope_limit: The A detector invocation is a single-file source probe. No whole-repository scan, product build, product caller path or actual Parcel runtime was exercised. Zero findings are not a safe verdict.
interpretation.ownership_implication: The missed pattern is generic heap allocation/write-width mismatch; B must confirm IPC/FFI boundary relevance before adding a specialized rule, and should avoid duplicating A's general C/C++ bounds responsibility.
